questions.question: J, K, L, M, N and O are six teachers. Each one teaches a different subject out of Hindi, English, Math, Science, Social Science and Arts, not necessarily in the same order. Each of them teaches on only one day, from Monday to Saturday, not necessarily in the same order. J teaches Arts on Saturday. L teaches neither English nor Social Science, but he teaches on Thursday. Wednesday is reserved for Maths taught by K. O teaches Science a day before N. Social Science is taught a day before Arts. Which subject is taught by L?

questions.question:
The statements below are followed by two conclusions labeled I and II. Assuming that the information in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with generally established facts, decide which conclusion(s) logically and definitely follow(s) from the information given in the statements.

**Statements:**

All butterflies are reptiles.

All reptiles are mammals.

**Conclusion:**

I. All mammals are butterflies.

II. All butterflies are mammals.

options.text: Either conclusion I or conclusion II follows.

questions.solution:
The least possible venn diagram is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2783719083746c89a0c57ec105ed9a408f9fb68a928420b506daa8076a9a8688.png] 

I. All mammals are butterflies. → False (As, All butterflies are reptiles and All reptiles are mammals → some mammals are butterflies)

II. All butterflies are mammals → True (As, All butterflies are reptiles and All reptiles are mammals → All butterflies are mammals)

Hence, only conclusion II follows.

questions.question:
Which number will follow next in the given number series?

7, 8, 16, 43, ?
questions.solution:
The logic is:

7 + 1³ = 8

8 + 2³ = 16

16 + 3³ = 43

43 + 4³ = 107

Hence, ’107’ is the correct answer.

15 : 270 :: 13 : ?
questions.solution:
The logic is:

15 : 270 → 15 × (15 + 3) = 270

Similarly,

13 : ? → 13 × (13 + 3) = 208

Hence, ‘208’ is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Find out the two signs to be interchanged to make the following equation correct.

14 + 16 × 14 − 7 ÷ 3 = 43
questions.solution:
1) – and ÷

Given expression: 14 + 16 × 14 − 7 ÷ 3 = 43

After interchanging the symbols, we get:

L.H.S = 14 + 16 × 14 ÷ 7 – 3

= 14 + 32 – 3

= 46 – 3

= 43 = R.H.S

2) × and ÷

Given expression: 14 + 16 × 14 − 7 ÷ 3 = 43

After interchanging the symbols, we get:

L.H.S = 14 + 16 ÷ 14 − 7 × 3

= 14 + 1.14 – 21

= 15.14 – 21

= -5.86 ≠ R.H.S

3) + and –

Given expression: 14 + 16 × 14 − 7 ÷ 3 = 43

After interchanging the symbols, we get:

L.H.S = 14 - 16 × 14 + 7 ÷ 3

= 14 – 224 + 2.33

= 16.33 – 224

= - 207.67 ≠ R.H.S

4) – and ×

Given expression: 14 + 16 × 14 − 7 ÷ 3 = 43

After interchanging the symbols, we get:

L.H.S = 14 + 16 - 14 × 7 ÷ 3

= 14 + 16 – 32.66

= 30 – 32.66

= -2.66 ≠ R.H.S

Hence, ‘– and ÷’ is the correct answer

• Column 2: 15 + 62 = 15 + 36 = 51
